Class JobValidator

java.lang.Object
com.example.tarecruitment.job.validator.JobValidator
public final class JobValidator extends Object
JobValidator - Job form validation. Responsible for required, length, format, dangerous input and date relationships; permissions, MO ownership, CSV write and other business flows in JobService. These error messages are directly displayed on MO publish/edit job form, so keep them plain and clear.
